def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    returns = [
        15.4, -6.2, 7.8, -14.3, 12.0, -9.1, 18.5, 25.7, -5.0, 3.3,
        21.2, -7.6, 11.7, 29.8, -19.4, 8.9, 4.5, -11.2, 6.6, -13.7
    ]
    winsor_percent = 0.10

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    sorted_returns = sorted(returns)
    count = int(len(sorted_returns) * winsor_percent)
    if count:
        lower_value = sorted_returns[count]
        upper_value = sorted_returns[-count - 1]
        winsorized_returns = (
            [lower_value] * count
            + sorted_returns[count:-count]
            + [upper_value] * count
        )
    else:
        winsorized_returns = sorted_returns

    answer = round(sum(winsorized_returns) / len(winsorized_returns), 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
